decisions.statement: Every page holding the key out of order is answered in this one answer.
Which pages hold the key out of order is read from the index.
A page is carried when a value it holds sits outside the longest run already in order.
The values of a page carried come out in the order they sort in.
One page's property is answered by one edit over that property.
The spelling a value already has is the spelling that value keeps.
A page stating no list under the key is refused by its path.
A key holding no list is passed over rather than refused.

definition: the values one key holds put into the order they sort in, on every page of one page type
